## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      7 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Sep 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Pia Kivelä_, Sep 18, 2026, 1/5: "Ever since the last update, the app has been extremely slow, glitchy and unrealiable. It takes forever to load any data. Cycle tracking is extremely slow and sometimes won't even save daily logs. All custom symptoms disappeared. On watch, the new way of pausing and finishing a workout is awful. I've paused my workout several times by accident. Sleep and energy scores takes forever to calculate. When viewing an exercise record, back button takes you to homepage instead of exercise list."
            2. _Salahuddin M_, Sep 18, 2026, 1/5: "Samsung Health was a very useful app of my Galaxy S24 FE to track my health data from Galaxy Watch 8. However recent update (version 7.00.6.011) make the previous excellent app useless. After update, app is continuously crashing while opening. Also an unsolicited card 'Fitness Index' is appearing automatically even after I removed it several times. 'Fitness Index' is a worthless feature, as lastest software update by Samsung for my phone is OneUI 8.5, whereas 'Fitness Index' require OneUI 9.0."
            3. _Hicks_, Sep 7, 2026, 1/5: "The app updated by Samsung requires One UI 9 on the watch - this will only be distributed over time. Until then, you have to expect bugs. In the end, the only thing that helps is reinstalling the app - synchronization is now working again for me. @Samsung: Great IT performance!! First lay the water pipe and then take care of the connections. The stupid user wastes his time skimming."
<!--/ir-theme-->
